    SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS return_ratio
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
LEFT JOIN returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
GROUP BY c.customer_segment
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r.return_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(oi.order_item_id) > 0.10

question: find customer_id, first_name, and last_name from the customers table that have orders and do not have returned order items
sql_gt: SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name FROM customers AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN returns AS r ON r.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id);
sql_pred:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name
FROM customers c
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM orders o 
    WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id
) AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 
    FROM order_items oi 
    JOIN returns r ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
    WHERE oi.order_id IN (
        SELECT order_id 
        FROM orders 
        WHERE customer_id = c.customer_id
    )
)

question: for each payment_method and category_name, compute average of quantity times unit_price - discount_amount by joining orders, order_items, products, and categories where AVG(quantity * unit_price - discount_amount) is greater than 50
sql_gt: SELECT o.payment_method, c.category_name, AVG(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) AS avg_line_revenue FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id JOIN categories AS c ON c.category_id = p.category_id GROUP BY o.payment_method, c.category_name HAVING AVG(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price - oi.discount_amount) > 50;
sql_pred:
SELECT 
    T1.payment_method,
    T4.category_name,
    AVG(T2.quantity * T2.unit_price - T2.discount_amount) AS avg_item_value
FROM 
    orders AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    order_items AS T2 ON T1.order_id = T2.order_id
INNER JOIN 
    products AS T3 ON T2.product_id = T3.product_id
INNER JOIN 
    categories AS T4 ON T3.category_id = T4.category_id
GROUP BY 
    T1.payment_method, T4.category_name
HAVING 
    AVG(T2.quantity * T2.unit_price - T2.discount_amount) > 50
